propositions: The module-size gate must read a single limit file (.github/module-size-limit.txt) containing 800 as an absolute cap, with no allowlist exemptions.
The gate must enforce a limit-lock: fetching main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and failing if the limit file differs from main's version (unless main lacks it for bootstrap).
The gate must fail if the limit file is missing and emit a warning (not silent skip) if the main fetch fails, falling through to the absolute cap.
Both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows must be rewritten to implement the new gate logic, reading only the limit file and no allowlist/ceilings files.

The contract test (test_module_size_contract.py) and workflow parity test (test_ci_workflow_parity.py) must be updated to validate the limit file and verify neither workflow references the obsolete allowlist/ceilings.
